title: Your Daily Coffee Isn't Why You're Broke — This Is
hook: Experts say skip the latte and retire rich. Nobel economists say that's mathematically absurd — and the real money drain is way bigger.
angle: Debunks the famous 'latte factor' myth using BLS data — housing, transport, and food overspending are worth 6x more than coffee over a lifetime
audience: Young adults who feel guilty about small purchases while massively overpaying on housing, cars, and food subscriptions
key_numbers: $4,800/yr: average housing overspend (32% actual vs 28% recommended)
$1M+: 40-year difference from fixing big three vs skipping coffee
